headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes at 332.70/80 to US dollar spot, bond yields steady
summary: The Sri Lankan rupee closed at 332.70/80 against the US dollar in spot trading, with bond yields steady. A Rs90bn treasury bill auction is scheduled for Wednesday.
why: The rupee's dollar rate and local bond yields are key gauges of Sri Lanka's currency stability and borrowing costs, which matter for investors in its sovereign debt.
